name: Aster-25 Anatomical
description: Human-proportioned articulated robotic hand: contoured palm, curved phalanges, rounded knuckles and compliant-pad concepts. Twenty independently actuated hand axes on a five-axis arm. Digital rigid-body engineering concept, not fabrication-ready hardware.
coordinate_convention: Right handed; local +Z along each link; palm +X palmar; +Y index/thumb side. Joint origins are parent-local; origin_rpy fixed XYZ roll pitch yaw.

links.name: base_link

geoms.name: BaseFixture
geoms.description: Anchors the arm to a rigid bench. Four 9 mm clearance holes on 180 mm PCD; rear service port; central cable passage. Anchoring, mass and bolt selection require structural validation.

geoms.name: BaseAccent
geoms.description: Visual trim and cover seam around the waist stage. Does not carry the arm load.

links.description: Bench-mounted base; conceptual plate requires bolts to a rigid work surface.

links.name: waist_link

geoms.name: WaistHousing
geoms.description: Rotating waist enclosure and central cable route. Its local Z axis follows the first arm joint; bearing and actuator interfaces remain conceptual.

geoms.name: ShoulderYokeL
geoms.description: Support cheek for shoulder pivot. Bore is a placeholder for a bearing-supported output shaft; bearing seat tolerance must be designed.

geoms.name: ShoulderYokeR
geoms.description: Support cheek for shoulder pivot. Bore is a placeholder for a bearing-supported output shaft; bearing seat tolerance must be designed.

links.description: Vertical yaw axis turns the entire arm left and right.

links.name: upper_arm

geoms.name: upperShell
geoms.description: 300 mm pivot spacing. Hollow concept housing with 16 mm pivot passages and a front service recess. Wall sizing and torque load paths require analysis.

geoms.name: upperCover
geoms.description: Removable front cover identifies cable and actuator service area. Fasteners, cable strain relief and a complete tendon spool package are not yet detailed.

geoms.name: upperRootBearingCover
geoms.description: External bearing cover and joint-axis marker. The orange bore ring is a visual reference, not a selected commercial bearing.

geoms.name: upperRootHubRing
geoms.description: High-contrast marker makes the simulated hinge axis visible when inspecting the mechanism.

geoms.name: upperTipBearingCover
geoms.description: External bearing cover and joint-axis marker. The orange bore ring is a visual reference, not a selected commercial bearing.

geoms.name: upperTipHubRing
geoms.description: High-contrast marker makes the simulated hinge axis visible when inspecting the mechanism.

links.description: 300 mm upper arm transfers shoulder torque to the elbow.

links.name: forearm

geoms.name: forearmCover

geoms.name: forearmRootBearingCover

geoms.name: forearmRootHubRing

geoms.name: forearmTipBearingCover

geoms.name: forearmTipHubRing

links.description: 250 mm forearm extends the elbow toward the wrist.

links.name: wrist_link

geoms.name: WristPitchHousing
geoms.description: 60 mm wrist stage. Pitch follows the local Y axis; a through-bore reserves cable space for the hand.

geoms.name: WristRollCollar
geoms.description: Visual collar at the hand roll interface. Rotation is around the palm Z axis; a slip ring and cable turn limit must be resolved for physical construction.

geoms.name: WristFlexionBoot
geoms.description: Smooth rounded external joint cover encloses the inherited forearm-to-wrist shell intersection. This visual cover represents a future flexible boot; it is excluded from rigid collision response and does not change the validated wrist articulation.

links.description: Wrist pitch tilts the palm; a five-axis arm cannot independently achieve every 6D pose.

links.name: palm_base

geoms.name: AnatomicalPalm
geoms.description: Smooth oval-section palm widens from a 48 mm wrist to an 82–84 mm metacarpal span. Four rounded knuckle lobes meet the finger roots. This surface defines the human-like palm envelope; internal actuation remains conceptual.

geoms.name: IndexMetacarpalLobe
geoms.description: Rounded palm-side knuckle transition joins the broad metacarpal contour to the corresponding articulated MCP carrier.

geoms.name: MiddleMetacarpalLobe
geoms.description: Rounded palm-side knuckle transition joins the broad metacarpal contour to the corresponding articulated MCP carrier.

geoms.name: RingMetacarpalLobe
geoms.description: Rounded palm-side knuckle transition joins the broad metacarpal contour to the corresponding articulated MCP carrier.

geoms.name: PinkyMetacarpalLobe
geoms.description: Rounded palm-side knuckle transition joins the broad metacarpal contour to the corresponding articulated MCP carrier.

geoms.name: ThenarEminence
geoms.description: The rounded muscular mound at the thumb base creates the asymmetric human palm silhouette and bridges the wrist to the thumb CMC socket. It is a rigid visual/collision envelope, not simulated muscle.

geoms.name: HypothenarEminence
geoms.description: A smaller rounded mound on the little-finger side completes the palm contour and provides a curved support surface.

geoms.name: CentralPalmPad
geoms.description: Oval, softly domed palmar contact insert. Frictional contact is modeled in physics; real elastomer compliance, durometer and attachment are not yet engineered.

geoms.name: ThenarPad
geoms.description: Curved thumb-base contact insert follows the thenar mound, helping the palm support objects during opposition.

geoms.name: DorsalPalmPanel
geoms.description: A thin rounded dorsal service panel follows the back-of-hand contour. Production fasteners and sealing remain to be selected.

geoms.name: WristSoftSeal
geoms.description: Narrow soft transition at the wrist preserves the natural palm taper while making the roll boundary visible.

links.description: 100 mm palm houses tendon paths and supports four finger bases and the opposable thumb. Palmar surface is +X.

links.name: index_knuckle

geoms.name: indexMCPBall
geoms.description: Rounded two-axis knuckle carrier supports independent finger spread and flexion at the same MCP center. Bearing/transmission hardware remains conceptual.

links.description: Co-located MCP spread carrier. Flexion hinge is at the same knuckle, not at the distal end of the proximal phalanx.

links.name: index_proximal

geoms.name: index_proximalShell
geoms.description: 40 mm joint spacing / terminal tip length. Smooth oval cross sections create a rounded knuckle, narrowed shaft and rounded distal knuckle. The shell follows its actual articulation frame; it is a solid digital envelope, not a fabrication-ready tendon housing.

geoms.name: index_proximalCrease
geoms.description: Short oval soft seam marks the flexion boundary and conceals the hinge interior. Rotation remains about the exact canonical Y hinge; soft deformation is not simulated.

geoms.name: index_proximalPin
geoms.description: Brushed-metal 2.1 mm reference pin makes the anatomical hinge axis visible. Pin fits, bearings and retention are conceptual.

geoms.name: index_proximalPad
geoms.description: Rounded oval palmar pad with domed contact surface. The contact shape and hinge follow the CAD mesh; friction is idealized and no tactile electronics are yet specified.

links.description: Index proximal phalanx, 40 mm hinge spacing; dark/teal pad contacts objects.

controller: Effort-limited position servos with model bias feedforward and rate-limited nominal references. Gravity acts normally; no body gravity cancellation.
